title: The Orchard of the Cape Route
author: Xanthe Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Lockridge, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
